response.sql: WITH per_state AS (SELECT p.death_state AS death_state, COUNT(DISTINCT h.player_id) AS cnt FROM hall_of_fame h JOIN player p ON p.player_id = h.player_id GROUP BY p.death_state), overall AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM per_state) SELECT AVG(ps.cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(ps.cnt - o.avg_cnt) AS avg_excess FROM per_state ps CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE ps.cnt > o.avg_cnt

assumptions.assumption: The average count across states is the unweighted mean of per-state distinct-player counts, with the NULL death_state group counted as one state in that mean.
Empty-string death_state values are treated as their own group (distinct from NULL) as stored; GROUP BY places all NULLs in one group.
Hall of Fame records of any category (player, manager, executive, etc.) count, since no category filter was requested, and inducted status is not required.
